name: Neutralidades que matam, de Juliana Garbayo
description: Livraria Essência do Livro hosts the book launch for Neutralidades que matam by Juliana Garbayo.
longDescription:
Livraria Essência do Livro hosts the launch of the book Neutralidades que matam, by Juliana Garbayo. The session takes place on 14 November 2026, starting at 11:00.

The venue is located at Rua da Alegria, 390, in Porto. Admission is free.
